reason: Our shopping list is already a WhatsApp group and the helper does a lot of the cooking, so I would not be the one snapping receipts. Free tier might get a look, but I would not pay for Plus.
objection: Recipes in these apps are Western, not what we cook. 400 recipes means nothing if they are not machboos, kabsa, molokhia and the rest of what my helper actually makes.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing that the recipes are mostly Gulf and Arabic dishes, and that my wife and the helper can both use the shared list in Arabic as easily as WhatsApp.
